row:
I  specialize in hands-on, natural approaches that support dogs’ comfort, movement, digestion, and overall well-being.
Through guided, step-by-step techniques, my work focuses on helping caregivers better understand what their dog’s body is communicating and how to respond safely and effectively. My approach emphasizes practical education, clarity, and confidence, so hands-on care feels approachable rather than intimidating.
In addition to in-practice work, I develop pre-recorded educational resources designed for pet parents. These programs support daily comfort, stress reduction, and a stronger human–animal bond, while remaining non-invasive.

My background blends animal wellness, client education, and program development, with a strong focus on accessibility, safety, and real-world application. Every resource is created with the goal of helping companions live well, and helping the people who care for them feel empowered in the process.


🦮 Kristina Dodge Canine Wellness
